origin.cohort_rule: 196 original 2025 source GWNO countries with both 2024 and 2025 data

protocol.primary_metric: paired mean Brier p_model minus p_baseline_global_5y over all 196 fixed country endpoints on first complete official source
protocol.training_rule: same 1-year country/state global-Laplace/shrink20 Markov transitions trained only through 2025; compose exactly three steps

target.binary_rule: 1 iff UCDP OrganizedViolenceCY official 2028 country-year state-based best fatalities >=25
target.missing_country_rule: unresolved, never assume absence is zero
target.source_release: first complete post-2028 UCDP OrganizedViolenceCY edition; later revisions sensitivity only
